hook_text: Nine provinces, one trail and a passport full of stamps.
clip_script: Mahikeng, North West. A Grade 5 class gets heritage passports, one page for each of the nine provinces. On the map, a dotted line winds across South Africa. Stop one: the Cradle of Humankind in Gauteng. Then Mapungubwe's golden rhino in Limpopo. The Castle in the Western Cape. The aloe in the Eastern Cape. Rock art in the Drakensberg. Heritage is what we inherit, value and pass on. Ready? Let's go.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with a dotted trail and little icons popping up, and a passport getting stamped at each stop.
mood: Excited and adventurous, like the start of a road trip.
pacing: Quick hops from stop to stop.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own heritage passport.
